Team —

Running the monthly "Unclaimed Opportunities" hygiene report and we have a short list of deals that either have no owner or have not had a meaningful update in 60+ days. These are skewing our forecast and finance wants a clean commit line by next Monday.

I exported the top 22 items (attached: stale-opps-report.csv) — please do one of the following for any row assigned to you or to your pod by Friday EOD (3/11):
- Claim: set yourself as owner in SFDC and add an evidence note (link to call notes, PO, or a short sentence why this will close).
- Transfer: if you are not owning the relationship, reassign the owner and notify me.
- Archive: if the opportunity is dead, set stage = Closed Lost and add a reason.

Key asks: attach close-evidence to the Opportunity where possible. Use the close-evidence-template.docx if you need a quick checklist.

Notable rows in the export:
- Medoryx — $420k, Stage: Proposal, Close date: 2028-04-15, No owner listed (was trial lead).
- StellarNet — $95k, Stage: Eval, Close date: 2028-03-30, Owner: lena@stellarnet.com (external lead; flagged).

I'll follow up with a short reconciliation on Monday morning. If you think any of these should be protected from archive (strategic), mark them and @me.

Thanks —
